help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: Get help using Onekof platform
help.documentationDesc: Browse our comprehensive guides and tutorials
help.faqCreateProject: How do I create a new project?
help.faqCreateProjectAnswer: Navigate to the Projects page and click the "Create Project" button. Fill in the project details and select your preferred template.
help.faqInviteMembers: How do I invite team members?
help.faqInviteMembersAnswer: Go to Settings → Team Members and click "Invite Member". Enter their email address and assign a role.
help.faqCustomizeDashboard: How do I customize my dashboard?
help.faqCustomizeDashboardAnswer: Admins can customize dashboard features by going to Settings → Customization. You can enable/disable sections and features based on your organization's needs.
help.faqExportDataAnswer: Most pages have an export button in the toolbar. Click it to download data in CSV or Excel format.
